about: Real-footage references for the basketball motion library. Links and timestamps only: the videos are not committed or redistributed. Local copies (if any) live outside the repo under local_root. Times are on the original video's timeline, in seconds. status: frame-read = consecutive frames read; tagged = seen on an overview sheet, not consecutive-frame confirmed; segment notes state the sampling interval and approximate window (legacy tags use 4-5 s; Booker tags use 1 s). speed: real = usable for timing; slow = slow-motion; mixed = cuts between both. playback_speed.value is the estimated fraction of live playback (1.0 = real time); each slow source and segment records a method and uncertainty. Segment values inherited from the Phantom compilation are source-level proxies, not per-clip measurements.

phantom_compilation.title: PHANTOM: THE NBA IN SLOW MOTION

playback_speed.method: Fit y(t)=c+v*t+0.5*a*t^2 to nine manually read ball centers at 0.1-s intervals from 1205.7-1206.5 in shot_tatum_ind, relative to the visible rim (rim center anchors z=3.05 m). In 640-px-wide frames the ball diameter is about 28 px (0.24 m), or 117 px/m; fitted acceleration is about 87 px/s^2 = 0.74 m/s^2, so sqrt(0.74/9.81)=0.275, rounded to 0.28.
playback_speed.uncertainty: +/-0.08; manual center and ball-diameter readings, short 0.8-s fit, and slight camera motion. Representative source proxy only; clip-to-clip rate variance is unmeasured.

segments.notes: Paired live version of reb_def_westbrook: Westbrook's 182nd career triple-double board vs Atlanta (May 10, 2021; clock 8:34-8:31). Read at 10 fps (40 frames, crop as given): scrum in the paint 392.5-394.4 s; players jump at the rim ~394.5-394.8 s; a Wizards player (navy, gold shoes) secures the ball ~395.0-395.1 s, turns, and dribbles up court from ~395.5 s. Jersey number not legible in the crop; identified as Westbrook from the full frame at 397.5 s (#0 carrying the ball up court). Broadcast wide shot: players ~100 px tall in the crop, hands and ball small.
Horford attacks the loose ball at the rim and tips it in with one hand; no two-hand gather or chest-level control. Paired live version: reb_putback_horford_live. REBOUND_BRIEF ref E.
